TEJAX KART / PLAYER HANDBOOK

Find your
racing line.

TEJAX KART is a free 3D browser racing game. Choose one of six cars and three circuits, then race, fight, or chase a faster lap. Desktop players launch directly in the browser; mobile players can install the game and enable tilt steering.

Desktop controls

ActionDefault control
AccelerateW or ↑
Brake / reverseS or ↓
Steer left / rightA / D or ← / →
Drift / boostSpace / Shift
Blaster / missileF / E, or left / right mouse
Mine / EMP / oilQ / T / G
Signature abilityX or Z
Camera / pauseC / Escape
Restart a solo raceR

A turns left and D turns right from the driver’s view while moving forward. Steering reverses when backing up, like a car. Change the four driving keys in Settings.

Mobile controls

Open Settings, tap Enable tilt, and allow motion access if asked. Hold your phone comfortably and tap Calibrate. Automatic acceleration is optional; hold BRAKE to slow or reverse. The touch joystick and GAS pedal work without motion permission. Read the mobile install and tilt guide.

Five ways to race

  • Race: complete three laps against five AI drivers. Weapons are disabled.
  • Combat: three laps with blasters, missiles, pickups and signature abilities.
  • Elimination: fight to be the last driver standing. No respawns.
  • Survival: survive escalating enemy waves, with repairs between rounds.
  • Time trial: drive three laps alone against the clock, without weapons.

Cross circuit checkpoints in order before the finish line. Shortcuts that skip checkpoints do not count as completed laps. The countdown and solo pause time are excluded from the race timer.

Automatic targeting and shooting

In Combat, Elimination and Survival, the blaster detects visible rivals ahead and fires automatically after a short acquisition delay. Aim leads moving cars and adjusts for elevation. Cloaked cars and targets behind a hill are not acquired. Turn off Auto-fire at detected rivals in Settings to fire manually with F, the mouse or the touch button. Press E for a guided missile; missiles are not fired automatically.

The cyan reticle identifies a target, and a white hit marker confirms a local impact. Standard rounds have cyan tracers; Rapid Fire uses purple streaks; Plasma Rounds have pink rings. Race and Time trial disable all weapons.

Pickups have distinct shapes, colors and text labels. Temporary buffs appear beside the speed display. Race and Time trial use only Repair, Nitro and Shield. LAN pickup effects are confirmed by the server.

Six cars, all unlocked

CarSpecialty and ability
ScoutLight interceptor; Hyper-warp gives a brief protected dash.
TitanHeavy armor; Fortress Barrier reflects missiles and strengthens ramming.
AssassinAgile specialist; Shadow Cloak breaks locks and deploys two mines in solo combat.
VectorBalanced chassis; Overclock Overdrive supplies boost and faster blaster fire.
ApexFast prototype; Hyper-warp favors speed over armor.
RallyDurable all-terrain car; Fortress Barrier rewards close combat.

Neo City emphasizes technical corners, Crimson Canyon has fast elevation changes, and Glacier Ridge has lower grip. Choose clear, rain, storm, or dynamic weather for solo play.

How does LAN multiplayer work?

LAN rooms support 2–6 players on the same self-hosted Node.js server. The public static website provides solo racing; it does not include a public matchmaking server.

  1. From a copy of the source repository, install Node.js 22 or newer.
  2. Run npm ci, then npm start in the project folder.
  3. On the host, open http://localhost:3000. Other players open http://YOUR-PC-LAN-IP:3000 on the same trusted network.
  4. Choose a car and circuit, create a room, and share its code. Everyone must connect to the same server. The host starts the race.

LAN matches use clear weather, and mines and oil are unavailable. The pit menu does not pause other drivers. Plain HTTP LAN addresses usually cannot access phone motion sensors: use touch controls there, or configure trusted HTTPS. Internet multiplayer requires a separately hosted secure WebSocket server.

Make the game run smoothly

Choose Performance graphics on phones or older computers, lower audio volume if desired, and disable camera motion if it is uncomfortable. Close unused tabs. Actual frame rate depends on device hardware and browser. If graphics are interrupted, reload the game. Keep the browser current and enable WebGL.

Where is progress saved?

Career totals, paint and settings are stored in this browser on this device. There is no cloud save. Credits are a career score, not a currency; all cars and paints are unlocked. Clearing browser data removes progress.
